placement_summary: Jeskai Way is a source-authored, review-gated raw packet. Its strongest source-bound signals are Blue-centered cunning, disciplined training, Red action, White structure, Khans-era monasteries and Ways, Narset and Shu Yun timeline boundaries, Ojutai discontinuity, modern Dragonstorm revival boundaries, and false-positive boundaries against generic color codes, Commander products, seed files, generated HTML, unsupported mechanics, and runtime promotion.

moral_and_psychological_profile.summary: Vox Mana models Jeskai as cunning through disciplined action: train perception until insight can move with courage, precision, compassion, and restraint. This is project interpretation from normalized VM-229 evidence plus VM-230/VM-231 shaping language, not official canon, and it has no live placement behavior in VM-232.
moral_and_psychological_profile.notes: Psychological language is Vox Mana synthesis. Support-only rows do not raise confidence.

core_values.label: Disciplined Perfection
core_values.description: Jeskai seeks improvement through knowledge, tools, practice, and self-command before action.

core_values.label: Cunning In Motion
core_values.description: Cunning becomes meaningful when insight, preparation, tempo, and protection turn into precise action.

core_values.label: Timeline Humility
core_values.description: Jeskai identity must keep Khans-era, Fate Reforged, Ojutai, and modern Dragonstorm material in the right eras.

behavioral_signals.signal: Look for Blue-centered Jeskai cunning, knowledge, preparation, disciplined action, martial practice, Red action, and White structure as primary language.
Look for Narset, Shu Yun, and Ojutai only when each reference stays in its evidence-backed era bucket.
Look for modern Dragonstorm-era revived Jeskai only when the era is explicit and not used to backfill Khans-era Jeskai Way.

inhibitor_traits: URW, WUR, RWU, UWR, RUW, or WRU color composition without a positive Jeskai evidence cluster
Generic spellslinger, prowess, artifacts, energy, cycling, copies, time counters, or Commander goodstuff without Jeskai evidence
Izzet-style Blue-Red experimentation without White discipline and Jeskai Way evidence
Azorius-style White-Blue order without Red action and Jeskai Way evidence
Boros-style Red-White action without Blue-centered perfection and Jeskai Way evidence
Ojutai clan treated as Khans-era Jeskai Way continuity
Modern Dragonstorm revival used as Khans-era proof
Commander product color identity treated as Tarkir canon
Color-pair philosophy files treated as Tarkir lore proof
Seed-file language or generated HTML treated as evidence
Exact mechanics, full six-fire doctrine, complete three-Ways hierarchy, full Narset biography, or full Shu Yun biography used without direct evidence

good_fit_indicators.text: The candidate centers Blue-led perfection, knowledge, discipline, Red action, White structure, and cunning with explicit Jeskai or Tarkir Way anchors.
The candidate uses monasteries, martial artists, mystics, wandering warriors, Annals, Rules of Reeds, fire-language, or three Ways as bounded Jeskai evidence.
The candidate clearly labels Narset, Shu Yun, Ojutai, or Dragonstorm context by era and avoids backfill.

ideal_fit_indicators: Blue-centered perfection plus Red action plus White shared form are all present.
Khans-era Jeskai Way evidence is present, and any Fate Reforged, Ojutai, or Dragonstorm material is timeline-labeled.
False positives are explicitly rejected: generic color code, Commander products, seed prose, generated HTML, exact mechanics, and backfilled timelines.
poor_fit_indicators: The candidate is only URW/WUR/RWU/UWR/RUW/WRU color identity.
The candidate is only Commander goodstuff or exact-color product identity.
The candidate treats Ojutai or modern Dragonstorm material as Khans-era Jeskai.
The candidate relies on exact prowess or named mechanics without card-data validation.
The candidate relies on seed files, generated HTML, color-pair philosophy, or architecture prose as proof.

discriminator_questions.question: Is the signal about disciplined cunning and trained insight rather than generic spellslinger play, color identity, or Commander support texture?
Does the candidate include a positive Jeskai evidence cluster beyond URW/WUR/RWU/UWR/RUW/WRU color identity?
Are Narset, Shu Yun, Ojutai, and Dragonstorm references held inside their timeline boundaries?

use_when: A user asks for discipline, cunning, martial training, Blue-led perfection, restrained action, monastery practice, or Jeskai-specific Tarkir flavor.
A user distinguishes Jeskai Way from generic Commander products or adjacent color-pair patterns.
A user wants timeline-labeled Tarkir clan identity rather than generic URW/WUR/RWU/UWR/RUW/WRU play patterns.
avoid_when: The user only mentions color-code identity.
The user centers Commander legality, exact decklists, or product facts.
The user asks for exact prowess or named mechanics without later card-data validation.
The user centers Ojutai continuity, Dragonstorm backfill, or seed-file claims as proof.
